content: A pair of high-profile bankruptcies in the auto space — First Brands Group and Tricolor Holdings LLC — has rattled Wall Street in recent weeks. The distress causing some investors to worry it might be a sign of a bigger issue in overall credit. Jeff Sherman, deputy CIO at DoubleLine Capital, and Amanda Lynam head of macro credit research at BlackRock, discuss credit on "Bloomberg Real Yield". (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Egypt Gets S&P Upgrade in Latest Sign of Economic Turnaround
content: S&P Ratings lifted Egypt’s credit rating, citing policy changes that have improved the economic outlook, giving a further boost for authorities after securing a $57 billion global bailout.
